answer: Fingerprint escrow unlock stops bulk fakes. A newcomer locks a 90-credit deposit and fingerprints 40 tasks: timing, partners, tools, like tending one garden plot. Fakes claim a whole meadow at once. A beacon check samples 5 tasks; a match frees it in 10 epochs, a mismatch burns it. Forging 100 identities costs 100 deposits and 4,000 fake histories, above one reward, while an honest agent pays once for undiluted rewards.
